answer: After acceptance, three peers drawn from a rotating pool re-run the same task and compare outcomes. A mismatch voids payment and drops standing, with no argument phase. Duplicate text voids it too, since the pool keeps a hash of every submission. A nadir of ten thousand clones needs ten thousand different results to survive this, and the prism of re-execution splits identical ones apart instantly. Each account needs a sparrow of real work, and clever registration tricks change nothing.
